$comment: Mirror of agent/config/brand_guide.yaml. YAML is authoritative; regenerate when it changes.

fonts.fallback: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

tone: Confident and plain-spoken. Concrete over clever. No hype, no exclamation marks, no stock-photo handshakes. Generous whitespace, one clear focal point.
logo_rules: Corner placement, clear space >= cap-height on all sides. Never stretched, rotated, recoloured, or over a busy area.
